message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you can pick from for a spooky Friday night marathon:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological thriller with an iconic score and chilling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | Modern dread, unsettling family drama, and a truly shocking finale. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Social satire meets horror; smart, tense, and thought‑provoking. |
| 4 | **It Follows** (2014) | Creepy premise, retro vibes, and a relentless sense of dread. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Daylight horror—beautiful yet disturbingly brutal. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silence is deadly; great tension and emotional stakes. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological terror wrapped in a mother‑daughter story. |
| 8 | **Suspiria** (1977) | Visually stunning, haunting soundtrack, and a cult classic vibe. |
| 9 | **The Witch** (2015) | Slow burn, period authenticity, and genuine supernatural creepiness. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Found‑footage realism that still feels fresh. |

Feel free to shuffle them into a binge‑list or pick one per night if you’re planning a week‑long horror marathon!
